chips.colour.text: Full colour, box drawing and accented text at native 1080p.
chips.colour.title: Colour and Unicode
chips.input.text: Keyboard, mouse or controller: every action works with each.
chips.input.title: Any input, alone
chips.lang.text: The app speaks all 21 languages of this site and follows your PS5's language. Linux stays as a normal Linux would be.
chips.lang.title: In your language
chips.native.text: ls, cat, cp, grep, sha256sum, ps, sysinfo and more, on the PS5's own files.
chips.native.title: Native shell
chips.search.text: Find text in the output, select it and paste it back.
chips.search.title: Search and copy
chips.ssh.text: Log in from your computer with a password or your own key.
chips.ssh.title: SSH and SFTP
chips.tabs.text: Up to four sessions, side by side if you like.
chips.tabs.title: Tabs and split panes
controls.kb.text: Type as usual. Shift+F10 opens the actions menu, Ctrl+Shift+S Settings. In a Linux program every F-key belongs to the program.
controls.kb.title: Keyboard
controls.lead: Use whichever you have. The hints on screen name the keys of what you used last.
controls.mouse.text: Click any button or on-screen key, drag to select, right-click for the menu and middle-click to paste.
controls.mouse.title: Mouse
controls.pad.text: Triangle opens the on-screen keyboard, R2 runs, L3 opens actions and Options Settings. Its keyboard has Esc, Tab, Ctrl, arrows and F1–F10.
controls.pad.title: Controller
controls.title: Keyboard, mouse or controller
credits.disclaimer.text: PS5Term is for research, education, interoperability and homebrew development. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. It is provided as is, without warranty: a modified console can be damaged, lose data or be banned, and the SSH server opens a port on your network. Use it at your own risk, only with hardware and content you own.
credits.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
credits.lead: Thank you to everyone behind these projects. Each keeps its own license; the full list is in the README and NOTICE.md.
credits.scene: PS5Term is one tool among many. If something here helps you, please support the people behind the PS5 scene's tools too.
credits.title: Built on other people's work
features.lead: Everything runs inside the app. No payload to send, no separate SSH server and no computer needed to use it.
features.linux.t1: RISC-V Linux 6.12 with BusyBox, curl with HTTPS, nano, tmux, htop, jq and less.
features.linux.t2: Files in /mnt/data stay between starts; add Alpine and its apk packages.
features.linux.t3: The PS5's own files are at /mnt/ps5. Internet goes out through the app; nothing can connect in.
features.linux.title: A real Linux shell
features.title: Your console, with a command line
foot.made: Made by PhantomPtr. PS5Term is free software under the GPL-3.0.
foot.sony: Not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment.
guide.s1.text: Download the ZIP from the latest release and copy the FAKE99260 folder in it to /data/homebrew/FAKE99260 on the console, for example with PS5Upload.
guide.s1.title: Download and copy
guide.s2.text: Launch it from your homebrew launcher. The built-in shell is ready; type help.
guide.s2.title: Open PS5Term
guide.s3.text: Open Settings (Options on the controller) to start Linux or switch on SSH. Settings shows the password and the exact command to connect.
guide.s3.title: Turn on what you need
guide.title: Get started in three steps
hero.fine: For a jailbroken PS5 with a homebrew launcher. Tested on firmware 13.60.
hero.lead: PS5Term runs on the console's own screen: a native shell for the PS5's files, a real Linux shell with curl, nano, tmux and htop, and SSH and SFTP from your computer. Use a keyboard, a mouse or just the controller.
hero.title: A real terminal, on your PS5.
meta.description: PS5Term is a terminal for a jailbroken PS5, on the console's own screen: a native shell for the PS5's files, a real Linux shell with curl, nano, tmux and htop, and SSH and SFTP from your computer. Free and open source.
meta.og: A terminal on your PS5's screen: a native shell, a real Linux shell, and SSH and SFTP from your computer. Free and open source.
meta.title: PS5Term — a terminal for your PS5
nav.coffee_title: PS5Term is free. A coffee for me, or tokens for the AI that writes the code, keeps it going.
ssh.lead: Both logins use the password shown in Settings, or your own public key. Replace the address with your console's.
ssh.linux.text: Starts Linux if it isn't running. Works with full-screen programs and terminal apps such as Ghostty and Warp.
ssh.linux.title: A Linux shell
